leadIn: After completing this lesson, you will be able to:
objectives: Apply border-radius to create rounded corners on HTML elements
Configure box-shadow properties to add depth and dimension to elements
Manipulate border-radius values to create different corner rounding effects
Construct layered shadow effects using multiple box-shadow declarations
Integrate border-radius and box-shadow to style interactive button components
Control the spread and blur radius of box-shadow for precise shadow effects
Implement elliptical corners by specifying horizontal and vertical border-radius values
